text: 这一讲用几分钟，把半周长线长，也就是 H P W L，从定义讲到代码。
In a few minutes: half-perimeter wirelength, or H P W L, from the definition to the code.
布局决定每个单元放在哪里；单元之间由线网相连。
Placement decides where each cell goes, and nets connect the cells.
真实导线要等到布线阶段才画出来，代价很高。
Real wires are only drawn at routing time, and that is expensive.
所以布局时，先用一个又快、又能比较的估计：H P W L。
So during placement we use a fast, comparable estimate instead: H P W L.
图里的细虚线只说明谁和谁相连，不是导线。
The thin dashed lines only show who connects to whom; they are not wires.
先看两个引脚。P 在 1、1，Q 在 5、4。横向差 4，纵向差 3。
Start with two pins. P at one, one. Q at five, four. Four across, three up.
H P W L 等于 4 加 3，等于 7。这就是曼哈顿距离，不是直线距离 5。
H P W L is four plus three, seven. That is the Manhattan distance, not the straight-line five.
芯片导线大多横平竖直。这条 L 形，只是许多等长路径之一。
Chip wires mostly run horizontally and vertically; this L is one of many equal-length paths.
四个引脚的线网 N 1。逐个读取引脚，记下最小和最大的 x 和 y。
A four-pin net, N one. Read the pins one by one, and keep the smallest and largest x and y.
P 给出初值。Q 刷新最大 x 和最大 y。R 再刷新最大 y。S 在内部，什么也不改。
P sets the start. Q raises max x and max y. R raises max y again. S is inside, and changes nothing.
宽是 7 减 1，等于 6；高是 6 减 1，等于 5；H P W L 等于 11。
Width: seven minus one, six. Height: six minus one, five. So H P W L is eleven.
把极值引脚 Q 向右拖。最大 x 从 7 变成 9，H P W L 从 11 变成 13。
Drag the extreme pin Q to the right. Max x goes from seven to nine, and H P W L from eleven to thirteen.
再把 Q 往下拉。越过 y 等于 1 时，最小 y 换成 Q，H P W L 变成 14。
Now pull Q down. Once it passes y equals one, Q becomes the minimum y, and H P W L becomes fourteen.
每一帧的数字都由同一组坐标当场重算。
Every frame recomputes the numbers from the same coordinates.
再移动内部引脚 S。只要留在绿色区域里，N 1 一直是 14。
Now move the interior pin S. While it stays in the green region, N one stays at fourteen.
但 S 也在线网 N 2 上。N 2 从 4 变成 2，总和从 18 变成 16。
But S is also on net N two. N two drops from four to two, and the total from eighteen to sixteen.
选中的线网没变，不等于总线长没变。
An unchanged net does not mean an unchanged total.
老师的例子有六个单元、六个线网。A B C D 是一个四引脚线网，只算一个包围盒。
The teacher's example has six cells and six nets. A B C D is one four-pin net, with a single box.
逐网计算：A B、C D、A C、B D 各为 8；A B C D 为 16；E F 为 4。
Net by net: A B, C D, A C and B D are eight each. A B C D is sixteen. E F is four.
总和是 8 乘 4，加 16，加 4，等于 52。
The total: eight times four, plus sixteen, plus four, is fifty-two.
写成代码，第一步先检查输入：未知引脚、空线网、坐标缺失，都要报错。
In code, validate first: unknown pins, empty nets and missing coordinates are errors.
然后对每个线网求最小、最大的 x 和 y，宽加高，累加到总和。
Then, for each net, take the min and max of x and y, and add width plus height to the total.
一次遍历全部引脚，代价与引脚总数成正比。
One pass over all pins; the cost grows linearly with the pin count.
记住：H P W L 等于宽加高，是包围盒周长的一半；多引脚线网只算一个盒子。
Remember: H P W L is width plus height, half the box perimeter, and a multi-pin net counts one box.
移动极值引脚会改变盒子；内部移动不改变这个线网，但可能改变别的线网。
Moving an extreme pin changes the box; an interior move leaves that net alone but may change others.
进阶片讲它的边界，比如为什么 H P W L 为 0，也不是好布局。
The advanced film covers its limits, such as why an H P W L of zero is not a good placement.
这是实验台。打开时载入老师的起始布局，总 H P W L 是 52。
This is the lab. It opens with the teacher's starter layout, with a total H P W L of fifty-two.
点一个线网，它的包围盒和极值引脚就会高亮，表格也同时更新。
Click a net to highlight its box and extreme pins; the table updates at the same time.
直接拖动单元。把 C 拖到 3、5，相关线网当场重算。
Drag a cell directly. Move C to three, five, and every net it touches is recomputed.
也可以用键盘：选中单元后按方向键；撤销按钮随时退回上一步。
Or use the keyboard: focus a cell and press the arrow keys. Undo steps back at any time.
逐步扫描一次读一个引脚，演示最小值和最大值怎样更新。
The step-by-step scan reads one pin at a time and shows how the min and max update.
切换到固定焊盘模式：A 和 D 被锁住，拖不动，状态栏会说明原因。
Switch to fixed-anchor mode: A and D are locked, and the status line says why they will not move.
看片时，随时按“试试这一帧”，实验台会接过画面上的真实坐标。
While watching, press Try this frame, and the lab takes over the exact coordinates on screen.
挑战检查的是你在实验台里的真实布局，不同的正确摆法都能通过。
Challenges check the real layout in your lab, so different correct arrangements all pass.
最后下载 Python 练习包，补全函数，用检查脚本验证你的实现。
Finally, download the Python pack, complete the functions, and verify them with the checker.
